comment: Curated retirements for app/data/rail-history.json. Each event names the N02 line/operator spelling and the last N02 release that still carried the section (year); build-jp-rail-history.py takes that release's geometry where it is absent from app/data/rail-sections.json. valid_to is the official 廃止日 / 新線切替日 (first day without the old section). An event with no kind is a closure. Optional kind: opening, closure, relocation, station_opening, station_closure, suspension, resumption, operator_transfer. Optional service_validity and infrastructure_validity are half-open [from, to] pairs (YYYY-MM-DD or null). The ride solver reads the service interval; valid_from/valid_to alone are that interval.
